value.title: Poetry of Armor Enthusiasts
value.synopsis: A mysterious beautiful girl named D. Emina suddenly appears. Her idol activities end up taking away all the customers. An eye for an eye, sexy equipment for sexy equipment, idol for idol! To save the store that is on the verge of bankruptcy, Lilietta, Flarearica, and the Demon King challenge Emina to an idol showdown...! Traveling adventurers. Welcome to the Adult Armor Shop.
